messages.title: Chhota Warkari × Mumbaicha Raja
messages.description:
The devotion of Wari in the city of Mumbaicha Raja!
Saint Tradition - Chapter 1
Let us discover the first Warkari who undertook the first Wari in our historic Wari tradition!
Pundalik Varade Hari Vitthal... Har Har Mahadev!
 Ram Krishna Hari!
